correction_reason: Study 001 used a zero no-trade band with daily evaluation, causing economically meaningless maintenance trades when the intended holding was unchanged. Study 002 changes only the no-trade band to the project's existing 2% execution assumption; signals, strategies, costs, states, blocks, and gates are unchanged.
purpose: Evaluate complete standalone bull-leadership and early-downside strategies with causal signals, explicit inactive holdings, next-open execution, actual entry and exit turnover, and costs on every material trade.

strategy_contracts.active_rule: Hold QQQ when the raw causal trend axis is either BULL_ACCELERATING or BULL_DECELERATING.
strategy_contracts.evidence_note: Broad literature-consistent positive-trend growth leadership control; not selected from one detailed result cell.

strategy_contracts.active_rule: Hold QQQ only when the raw causal trend axis is BULL_DECELERATING.
strategy_contracts.evidence_note: Explicitly post-selection and exploratory because the allocation-gap study identified this state pair.

strategy_contracts.active_rule: Hold BIL on the first raw causal BEAR_DETERIORATING signal.
strategy_contracts.evidence_note: Tests whether removing the three-session confirmation delay makes downside defense actionable.

strategy_contracts.active_rule: Hold BIL only after three consecutive raw causal BEAR_DETERIORATING signals.
strategy_contracts.evidence_note: Timing control that isolates the effect of confirmation delay.

strategy_contracts.active_rule: Hold BIL on the first raw causal TRANSITION_DETERIORATING or BEAR_DETERIORATING signal.
strategy_contracts.evidence_note: Tests an earlier deterioration family without tuning continuous thresholds.

signal_contract.long_term: SPY close relative to its trailing 200-session arithmetic mean
signal_contract.acceleration: current SPY 20-session return minus its value five sessions earlier
signal_contract.signal_time: session close using data through that close
